name: power-bi
description: Use Power BI, a Microsoft Fabric service, to explore reports, build visuals, and publish dashboards in your local desktop browser.

interface.shortDescription: Explore and author analytics in your browser
interface.longDescription: Use Power BI, a Microsoft Fabric service, to explore reports, build visuals, and publish dashboards in your browser. Requires local browser access in ChatGPT Desktop or desktop Codex; not available on web, mobile, or cloud-backed tasks. Built and maintained by OpenAI. Uses the organization's web interface and the signed-in account's existing permissions; browser availability, product edition, and role determine supported actions. No API or MCP connection is included.
defaultPrompt: Explain this Power BI report, including its filters and underlying data.
Create a report from this semantic model and pin the key visuals to a dashboard.
Update this report's visuals and publish it to the workspace I specify.
